title: WumboLabs eval profile descriptor
description: Stable scientific profile identity, independent of repository boundaries. Version 2 descriptors live beneath models/<model_id>/profiles/<profile_id> in WumboLabs/evaluations. Version 1 descriptors remain historical evidence.

model_id.description: Stable model identity; maps to exactly one canonical Labs page (e.g. qwen38-27b).

profile_id.description: Materially distinct tested deployment/scientific surface; not a repository identity.

runtime_family.description: Runtime engine family (e.g. llama.cpp, ExLlamaV3, vLLM).

runtime_version.description: Pinned runtime version/commit identity where established.

artifact.description: Tested model artifact identity (file/quant family, source revision where established).

artifact_precision.description: Weight/KV precision of the tested artifact.

deployment_topology.description: Material serving topology of the profile (residency, speculation/MTP surface, history mode, batch/width), where applicable.

hardware_scope.description: Hardware scope of the evidence (e.g. WumboJetsII, RTX 5070 12GB).

repository.description: Current descriptors use WumboLabs/evaluations; historical descriptors retain their original owner/name.

first_event.description: event_id of the first published event on this profile.

current_status.description: Published profile role. Historical classification vocabulary is retained rather than scientifically reclassified during migration.

notes.description: Optional bounded clarification (e.g. provenance of a split repository).
